title: Financial Institutions, Capital Markets & Insurance Licensing
description: The sequential regulatory roadmap for banks, fintechs, fund managers, insurance brokers, and pension trustees to secure operating authorisations from the Bank of Ghana (BOG), SEC, NIC, and NPRA.

steps.title: Bank of Ghana (BOG) Banking & Payment Systems Licensing
steps.why: Banks, specialized deposit-taking institutions (SDIs), microfinances, and Dedicated Electronic Money Issuers (fintechs) must satisfy capital adequacy and receive BOG licensing under Act 930.
steps.do_this_when: Before operating any deposit-taking, foreign exchange bureau, or mobile payment services.

options.label: Bank of Ghana Licensing Approval & Requirements Portal
options.notes: Official supervisory and regulatory licensing download requirements.

steps.title: Securities & Exchange Commission (SEC) Operator Licensing
steps.why: Fund managers, broker-dealers, investment advisers, and mutual funds must obtain market operator licences under the Securities Industry Act 2016 (Act 929).
steps.do_this_when: Before managing public investment capital or trading securities.

options.label: SEC License Application Forms (SECFORM1)
options.notes: Direct application form for capital market operators.

steps.title: National Insurance Commission (NIC) Insurer & Broker Licensing
steps.why: Under the Insurance Act 2021 (Act 1061), insurance companies, reinsurance firms, brokers, and loss adjusters must be licensed by the NIC.
steps.do_this_when: When establishing insurance underwriting or broking entities.

options.label: National Insurance Commission Licensing Requirements
options.notes: Regulatory requirements for insurers, brokers, and agents.

steps.title: NPRA Pension Trustee & Scheme Registration
steps.why: Corporate pension trustees, fund custodians, and Tier 2/3 occupational pension schemes must be registered under the National Pensions Act (Act 766).
steps.do_this_when: When registering occupational or personal pension schemes.

options.label: NPRA Scheme and Trustee Registration Forms
options.notes: Application downloads for corporate trustees, custodians, and schemes.

steps.title: ICAG Practising Certificate & Audit Firm Registration
steps.why: Auditors and accounting firms signing statutory company financial statements must hold an active practising licence issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants Ghana.
steps.do_this_when: For professional accountants offering audit and statutory accounting services.

options.label: ICAG Acquisition of Practising Licence
options.notes: Requirements and application for professional accountancy practising licence.
